tooltip.tconaffixes.currency.recast: Rerolls every affix, its tier, value, and the affix count.
tooltip.tconaffixes.currency.add: Adds one compatible affix, up to three prefixes and three suffixes.
tooltip.tconaffixes.currency.preserve_pr: Keeps all prefixes and rerolls the entire suffix side.
tooltip.tconaffixes.currency.preserve_su: Keeps all suffixes and rerolls the entire prefix side.
tooltip.tconaffixes.currency.mutate: Irreversibly improves or destroys the part.
tooltip.tconaffixes.currency.use: Right-click to select; left-click a part. Hold Shift to repeat.
tooltip.tconaffixes.salvage_hint: Shift-right-click in an inventory to strip and salvage.
message.tconaffixes.targeting: Choose a Tinkers part · Shift repeats
message.tconaffixes.operation.incompatib: That currency cannot affect this part.
message.tconaffixes.operation.no_affixes: That part has no affixes to change.
message.tconaffixes.operation.full: That part has no compatible open affix slot.
message.tconaffixes.operation.needs_both: Preservation requires at least one prefix and one suffix.
screen.tconaffixes.mutate.title: Risk the entire part?
screen.tconaffixes.mutate.message: Ruinous Flux permanently locks survivors and has a 20% chance to destroy the part.
screen.tconaffixes.salvage.title: Strip every affix?
screen.tconaffixes.salvage.message: The material part survives. Its natural salvage payout can only be claimed once.
modifier.tconaffixes.affix_stats.descrip: Reapplies the stat rolls carried by affixed parts.
